name: London
living: Big Ben's clock face glows warm and its lantern catches a slow golden glint
the London Eye turns imperceptibly, its rim lights chasing around the wheel
a red double-decker bus glides along the road behind the stands now and then (cut the painted bus into a sprite)
heavy grey clouds drift slowly, golden light breathing through the gaps (sky layer drift)
floodlight banks glow and softly pulse, fine misty motes hanging in their cones
the flags and banners on the poles above the stands flutter
office windows in the City towers flicker on as evening falls
the scoreboard's pixel diamond lights up its bases on a home run
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
